comparison.objective: Candidate mechanically sets a gripper stop; this record calibrates a robot TCP by touching one reference point from multiple tool orientations.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate counterholds a screw while tightening its jam nut; the record pivots a mounted tool around a stationary tip with angular diversity.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a locked angle retained through actuation; the record requires several accurate contact poses with sufficient orientation spread and no tool-mount drift.
comparison.reason: TCP pivot calibration tests pose control around a contact point, not coupled adjustment-and-locking under reaction torque.
